name: David Ballard
headline: Professional Services Leader | Scaling Delivery, Driving Client Outcomes, Building High-Performing Teams
about:
Professional Services executive with 15+ years leading enterprise SaaS and AI-driven delivery, owning P&L and driving revenue, margin, and customer outcomes at scale. Proven in building high-performing global teams, executing complex programs, and partnering with C-level stakeholders to align services with business strategy.

Expert in transforming services organizations through standardized delivery, strong governance, and optimized forecasting, resourcing, and deal support. Known for operational rigor, decisive leadership, and embedding AI-driven innovation to accelerate customer value and reduce risk.
… more

experiences.description:
Lead Professional Services delivery across the Americas at OpenText, with full accountability for revenue, margin, and successful execution of enterprise software implementations. Direct a distributed team of project and program leaders, aligning delivery with sales and customer objectives while managing complex programs, forecasting performance, and resolving escalations across Fortune 500 clients.

Drive transformation of the services delivery model by standardizing project management practices, improving bid/scoping rigor, and optimizing resource planning to increase efficiency and margin. Partner with senior leadership to embed AI-driven innovation into delivery, enhance customer communication, and proactively manage program risk, while building high-performing teams focused on consistent, high-quality outcomes.

Provided executive advisory to leadership teams on CX market trends, AI-driven automation, and Professional Services transformation, shaping go-to-market and delivery strategies to drive efficiency and customer value.

Led high-performing services project delivery (PMO), sales, and operations teams, driving revenue growth in a quota-carrying business. Developed and executed a services sales strategy, optimizing pipeline management, defining offerings, and enabling high-performance sales execution, which contributed to significant sales growth. 

Empowered and managed teams through a servant leadership approach, fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability to drive positive customer outcomes. Served as an executive sponsor for key accounts, strengthening partnerships to enhance customer success and business growth while effectively managing escalations for timely resolution and client satisfaction. Spearheaded a transformational organizational redesign as the company transitioned to a Cloud/SaaS-first model focused on business outcomes.

Managed a portfolio of over 200 concurrent projects and engagements, overseeing $20M+ in annual revenue. Ensured project success, accurate forecasting, and continuous revenue growth. 

Led strategic services planning and operations, defining service offerings and packages, optimizing organizational structure, and driving process improvements with enhanced reporting. 

Additionally, mentored and coached portfolio managers and directors, fostering leadership development and operational excellence.

Served as Services Director for multimillion-dollar accounts, overseeing delivery, customer success, financial management, and reporting while building strategic C-level relationships. Led sales and business development in a quota-carrying role, managing pre-sales activities, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, scoping, SOW creation, and contract negotiations. 

Directed the Project Management Practice to ensure high-quality, consistent solution delivery while standardizing both waterfall and agile delivery frameworks. Recruited and onboarded new project managers to support the practice’s expansion and developed a comprehensive delivery methodology, including project checklists, document templates, and training materials. 

Additionally, mentored and trained project managers, fostering professional growth and excellence in project execution.

Responsible for project delivery throughout all stages of the software development lifecycle. Primarily served as Project Manager who led, coached and mentored the delivery team. Vast industry experience provided the skill to successfully engage technical and business discussions to identify, understand, and analyze complex customer problems, which lead to innovative solutions.

Accountable for quality and delivery of key enterprise CRM projects at Sword Ciboodle. Managed multiple successful implementations of large multi-vendor projects across multiple locations and time zones. As a strategic consultant, advised several Fortune 500 companies on how to improve their CRM strategies.

Designed and implemented CRM solutions for a diverse range of customers across the UK, tailoring systems to meet unique business needs. Thrived in a fast-paced and challenging environment, sharpening key consultancy skills and building a strong foundation in both the IT consultancy and CRM industries.
